lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of circular high-luminance spots are visible across the mid-lateral flank. A primary row of five equidistant spots is observed extending from below the first dorsal fin towards the caudal peduncle, with a secondary parallel row of larger spots situated ventrally.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with a high-intensity upper edge and a shadowed lower margin, extending from the level of the first dorsal fin posteriorly.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots, primarily localized near the basal attachment point and along the posterior trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the upper posterior margin of the first dorsal fin, suggesting a previous amputation or physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible portion of the pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more tightly clustered high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank patterning.
